chunks.content:
In these regulations, unless the context otherwise requires, 

- (a) .. Act'· means the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999(41 of 1999) . 

- (b) '·Authority" means the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority established under sub-section ( 1} of Section 3 of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act. 

- (c} "Chairperson .. means the Chairperson of the Authority. 

- (d) "Committee .. means every committee of the members formed by general or special order in writing by the Authority, pursuant to the provisions of subsection (2) of section 23 of the Act. 

- (e) "Designated Officer .. means any officer of the Authority charged "',jrh the duty and responsibility of issuance of notice, circulation of agenda, recording, circulation and safe-keeping of minutes of the meetings of the Authority or any Committee thereof.
